name: Load and verify boundary geometry
title: Load and verify boundary geometry
description:
A boundary links to its dataset and may link to a parent boundary and an administrative area. Use a stable boundary code, source ID, label, level, and source classification; include all four west/south/east/north bounds and valid WGS84 geometry rows. Geometry input is not a place to simplify away licensing or provenance.

Start with a small, authorized test dataset. Confirm the importer reports successful features, that the geometry renders in the map and bounds contain the expected region, and that parent/area links are coherent. Keep the bundled coarse world-country shapes clearly distinguished from authoritative operational boundaries.
